A.OPEN_DATE AND A.CLOSE_DATE AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN B.OPEN_DATE AND B.CLOSE_DATE AND B.COM_CODE = Z.BUYER AND A.SLG_ID = 'P04-4041-06') AS EARLY_END_FLAG, Z.SPECIFICATION, Z.MAKER_NAME, Z.ORIGN_NAME, Z.QUOTA_CNT, Z.AGENT, Z.AGENT_NAME, Z.ATOB_UNIT_PRICE, Z.STOA_LIST_PRICE, Z.RATE, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(Z.ATOS_DATE,'YYYY/MM/DD'),'YYYY/MM/DD') AS ATOS_DATE, Z.KEP_USER_ID, Z.KEP_USER, Z.BTOA_USER_ID, Z.BTOA_USER_NAME, Z.BTOA_USER_TEL, Z.RQDT_STATUS, Z.UNIT_MEASURE, Z.LEAD_TIME, Z.ATOS_REMARK, Z.BUYER_TARGET_PRICE, Z.ADMIN_TARGET_PRICE, Z.BYCA_COMORG_CODE, Z.END_TIME_FLAG, Z.ITEM_QTY, Z.ATOS_END_DT, Z.ATOS_END_DATE, Z.IMAGE_KEY, Z.STOA_REMARK, CASE WHEN Z.STOA_REMARK IS NULL THEN DECODE((SELECT COUNT(MNG.ADD_NOTE) FROM KEP_RQDT_NOTE_MNG MNG WHERE MNG.BUYER = Z.BUYER AND MNG.QUOTATION_NO = Z.QUOTATION_NO AND MNG.QUOTATION_SEQ = Z.QUOTATION_SEQ AND MNG.REVISION = Z.REVISION AND MNG.STATUS != 'D'),0 ,'6','5') ELSE '5' END STOA_REMARK_IMG, Z.BTOA_END_DT, Z.REG_ITEM_NO, Z.SEND_FLAG, Z.CONTRACT_NO, Z.CONTRACT_SEQ, Z.RATE_FLAG, Z.CMS_CATLG_ID, Z.SG_ID, Z.REFER_MAPPING_FLAG, Z.ATOB_REMARK, Z.SELLER_IMAGE_KEY, Z.ITEM_GROUP, Z.AGENT_MIN_PRICE, Z.DUTY_KEP, Z.RFQ_KEP_USER, Z.RFQ_KEP_USER_NAME, Z.PLANT , DECODE(NVL(Z.AGENT_OPEN_FLAG,'Y'),'Y',1,0) AS AGENT_OPEN_FLAG , NVL(Z.CP_AGENT_OPEN_FLAG,'Y') AS CP_AGENT_OPEN_FLAG , Z.CANCEL_REMARK , CASE WHEN Z.CANCEL_REMARK IS NULL THEN '6' ELSE '5' END CANCEL_REMARK_IMG , Z.BTOA_REMARK , Z.BELOW_COMORG_CODE AS INIT_BELOW_COMORG_CODE , Z.MSDS_YN , Z.MSDS_NO , Z.SG_KEP_YN , Z.SG_GBN , (SELECT DECODE(COUNT(COD3.CODE2),0,'N','Y') FROM ICOMCOD3 COD3 WHERE COD3.TYPE = 'MAP' AND COD3.BUYER = 'KRKORE0001' AND COD3.CODE2 = Z.BUYER AND COD3.FLAG = 'Y') AS MAP_YN , Z.ADMIN_CLOSE_FLAG , Z.JOB_TRANSFER_NM , Z.JOB_TRANSFER_ID , Z.JOB_TRANSFER_DATE , Z.MAKER_PART_NO , Z.MAKER_CODE , Z.SOUR_MNG , Z.EXTEND_FLAG , Z.DELAY_REASON_IMG , Z.DELAY_REASON_CODE , Z.DELAY_SEND_MAIL_FLAG , Z.REF_NO , DECODE(Z.PROCESS_TYPE, '0', '직납', '1', '재고', '2', 'TR', '3', 'VMI', '') AS PROCESS_TYPE , Z.MIN_ORDER_QTY , Z.PUR_UNIT_QTY , Z.BUYER_MSDS_YN , Z.PLANT_USER_NM , Z.PGM_VARIABLE , (SELECT TO_CHAR(MAX(A.CREATE_DATE),'YYYY/MM/DD HH24:MI') from KEP_USE_PGM_MNG A WHERE A.PGM_NAME = 'RQ_NEW_MS' AND A.PGM_VARIABLE = Z.PGM_VARIABLE) AS QTDT_MAIL_SEND_DATE , Z.BYIT_STATUS , Z.BYIT_PRODUCT_CLOSE_FLAG , Z.QTDT_ADD_USER_NM , Z.WAREHOUSE_CODE , Z.RQDT_PROCESS_TYPE , Z.ATOA_REMARK , (SELECT MAX(B.USER_NAME_LOC) FROM ICOMCOD3 A, ICOMLUSR B WHERE A.BUYER ='KRKORE0001' AND A.TYPE ='CMDSM' AND A.CODE1 =Z.SG_ID AND A.TEXT1 = B.USER_ID AND A.TEXT2 = 'Y') AS DSM_MNG_NM , Z.AFTER_CMS_REJECT_YN , Z.AFTER_ITEM_CHG_REQ_ID , (SELECT USR.USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR USR WHERE USR.USER_ID = Z.AFTER_ITEM_CHG_REQ_ID) AS AFTER_ITEM_CHG_REQ_NM , TO_CHAR(Z.AFTER_ITEM_CHG_REQ_DATE, 'YYYY/MM/DD HH24:MI') AS AFTER_ITEM_CHG_REQ_DATE , Z.AFTER_ITEM_CHG_REQ_NOTE , DECODE(Z.AFTER_ITEM_CHG_REQ_IMAGE_KEY,'',10,11) AS AFTER_ITEM_CHG_REQ_IMAGE_KEY_IMG , Z.AFTER_ITEM_CHG_REQ_IMAGE_KEY , Z.AFTER_ITEM_MD_USER_ID , (SELECT USR.USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR USR WHERE USR.USER_ID = Z.AFTER_ITEM_MD_USER_ID) AS AFTER_ITEM_MD_USER_NM , TO_CHAR(Z.AFTER_ITEM_MD_DATE, 'YYYY/MM/DD HH24:MI') AS AFTER_ITEM_MD_DATE , Z.AFTER_ITEM_MD_REVISION , Z.RQDT_CNT , (SELECT DECODE(COUNT(*), 0, 'N', 'Y') FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE='ALRE' AND CODE=Z.BUYER AND FLAG='Y') AS ALL_RQDT_FLAG , Z.ASSIGN_AGENT_CODE , (SELECT DECODE(COUNT(A.SLG_ID), 0, 'N', 'Y') FROM BNTSLGDEF A, BNTSLGIMP B WHERE A.SLG_ID = B.SLG_ID AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN A.OPEN_DATE AND A.CLOSE_DATE AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN B.OPEN_DATE AND B.CLOSE_DATE AND B.COM_CODE = Z.BUYER AND A.SLG_ID = 'P04-4041-09') AS UNIT_PRICE_CHECK_FLAG , (SELECT DECODE(COUNT(A.SLG_ID), 0, 0, MAX(B.COL01_DATA)) FROM BNTSLGDEF A, BNTSLGIMP B WHERE A.SLG_ID = B.SLG_ID AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN A.OPEN_DATE AND A.CLOSE_DATE AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN B.OPEN_DATE AND B.CLOSE_DATE AND B.COM_CODE = Z.BUYER AND A.SLG_ID = 'P04-4041-09') AS MIN_UNIT_PRICE , (SELECT DECODE(COUNT(A.SLG_ID), 0, 9999999999, MAX(B.COL02_DATA)) FROM BNTSLGDEF A, BNTSLGIMP B WHERE A.SLG_ID = B.SLG_ID AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN A.OPEN_DATE AND A.CLOSE_DATE AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN B.OPEN_DATE AND B.CLOSE_DATE AND B.COM_CODE = Z.BUYER AND A.SLG_ID = 'P04-4041-09') AS MAX_UNIT_PRICE , (SELECT DECODE(COUNT(A.SLG_ID), 0, 'N', 'Y') FROM BNTSLGDEF A, BNTSLGIMP B WHERE A.SLG_ID = B.SLG_ID AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN A.OPEN_DATE AND A.CLOSE_DATE AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN B.OPEN_DATE AND B.CLOSE_DATE AND B.COM_CODE = Z.BUYER AND A.SLG_ID = 'P04-4041-13') AS QUOT_SEND_BLOCK_FLAG , (SELECT DECODE(COUNT(A.SLG_ID), 0, 'N', 'Y') FROM BNTSLGDEF A, BNTSLGIMP B WHERE A.SLG_ID = B.SLG_ID AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN A.OPEN_DATE AND A.CLOSE_DATE AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN B.OPEN_DATE AND B.CLOSE_DATE AND B.COM_CODE = Z.BUYER AND A.SLG_ID = 'P04-4041-11') AS REMARK_FLAG , Z.BTOA_NEGO_PRICE , Z.CMC_REQ_DATE , Z.CMC_REQ_NO , (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 COD WHERE COD.TYPE = 'CM01' AND COD.CODE = Z.CMC_REQ_STATUS) AS CMC_REQ_STATUS , Z.AFTER_ITEM_MD_COMPLETE , Z.AFTER_ITEM_CHG_REQ_TYPE , Z.CMS_CATEG_ID , CASE WHEN TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(Z.BTOA_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD') + 5, 'YYYYMMDD') > Z.BTOA_END_DATE THEN CASE WHEN TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') > TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(Z.BTOA_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD') + 5, 'YYYYMMDD') THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END ELSE CASE WHEN TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') > Z.BTOA_END_DATE THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END END AS DELAY_FLAG FROM ( SELECT X.BUYER, X.BUYER_NAME, X.QUOTATION_NO, X.QUOTATION_SEQ, X.REVISION, X.AGENT_REVISION, X.REVICNT, X.BTOA_DATE, X.BTOA_END_DATE, X.SIGNAL, X.BUYER_ITEM_NO, X.STATUS, X.DESCRIPTION, X.SPECIFICATION, X.MAKER_NAME, X.ORIGN_NAME, X.QUOTA_CNT, X.AGENT, X.AGENT_NAME, X.ATOB_UNIT_PRICE, X.STOA_LIST_PRICE, X.RATE, X.ATOS_DATE, X.KEP_USER_ID, X.KEP_USER, X.BTOA_USER_ID, X.BTOA_USER_NAME, X.BTOA_USER_TEL, X.RQDT_STATUS, X.UNIT_MEASURE, X.LEAD_TIME, X.ATOS_REMARK, X.BUYER_TARGET_PRICE, X.ADMIN_TARGET_PRICE, X.BYCA_COMORG_CODE, X.END_TIME_FLAG, X.ITEM_QTY, X.ATOS_END_DT, X.ATOS_END_DATE, X.IMAGE_KEY, X.STOA_REMARK, X.BTOA_END_DT, X.REG_ITEM_NO, X.SEND_FLAG, X.CONTRACT_NO, X.CONTRACT_SEQ, X.RATE_FLAG, X.CMS_CATLG_ID, X.SG_ID, X.REFER_MAPPING_FLAG, X.ATOB_REMARK, X.SELLER_IMAGE_KEY, X.ITEM_GROUP, X.AGENT_MIN_PRICE, (SELECT NVL(MAX(KEP_USER_ID),'') FROM MIS_BUYER_MNG WHERE YEAR = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY') AND BUYER = X.BUYER AND STATUS = 'C' AND KEP_USER_ID = #{st_user_id}) AS DUTY_KEP, X.RFQ_KEP_USER, X.RFQ_KEP_USER_NAME, X.PLANT , X.AGENT_OPEN_FLAG , X.CP_AGENT_OPEN_FLAG , X.CANCEL_REMARK , X.BTOA_REMARK , X.BELOW_COMORG_CODE , DECODE(NVL(X.MSDS_YN,'Y'),'Y','1','0') AS MSDS_YN , X.MSDS_NO , X.SG_KEP_YN , X.SG_GBN , X.ADMIN_CLOSE_FLAG , X.JOB_TRANSFER_NM , X.JOB_TRANSFER_ID , X.JOB_TRANSFER_DATE , X.MAKER_PART_NO , X.MAKER_CODE , X.SOUR_MNG , X.EXTEND_FLAG , X.DELAY_REASON_IMG , X.DELAY_REASON_CODE , X.DELAY_SEND_MAIL_FLAG , X.REF_NO , X.PROCESS_TYPE , X.MIN_ORDER_QTY , X.PUR_UNIT_QTY , X.BUYER_MSDS_YN , X.PLANT_USER_NM , X.BUYER||X.QUOTATION_NO||X.QUOTATION_SEQ||X.REVISION AS PGM_VARIABLE , X.BYIT_STATUS , X.BYIT_PRODUCT_CLOSE_FLAG , X.QTDT_ADD_USER_NM , X.WAREHOUSE_CODE , X.RQDT_PROCESS_TYPE , X.ATOA_REMARK , X.AFTER_CMS_REJECT_YN , X.AFTER_ITEM_CHG_REQ_ID , X.AFTER_ITEM_CHG_REQ_DATE , X.AFTER_ITEM_CHG_REQ_NOTE , X.AFTER_ITEM_CHG_REQ_IMAGE_KEY , X.AFTER_ITEM_MD_USER_ID , X.AFTER_ITEM_MD_DATE , X.AFTER_ITEM_MD_REVISION , X.RQDT_CNT , X.ASSIGN_AGENT_CODE , X.BTOA_NEGO_PRICE , (SELECT TO_CHAR(REQ_DATE, 'YYYY/MM/DD HH24:MI') FROM KEP_CMC_REQ WHERE REQ_NO = X.CMC_REQ_NO) AS CMC_REQ_DATE , X.CMC_REQ_NO , (SELECT REQ_STATUS FROM KEP_CMC_REQ WHERE REQ_NO = X.CMC_REQ_NO) AS CMC_REQ_STATUS , X.AFTER_ITEM_MD_COMPLETE , X.AFTER_ITEM_CHG_REQ_TYPE , X.CMS_CATEG_ID FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT A.BUYER AS BUYER, CP.COM_NAME_LOC AS BUYER_NAME, A.QUOTATION_NO, A.QUOTATION_SEQ, A.REVISION, B.AGENT_REVISION, A.REVISION || '/' || B.AGENT_REVISION AS REVICNT, A.BTOA_DATE, A.BTOA_END_DATE, BI.STATUS AS BYIT_STATUS, BI.PRODUCT_CLOSE_FLAG AS BYIT_PRODUCT_CLOSE_FLAG, CASE WHEN BI.BUYER_ITEM_NO IS NULL AND (BI.STATUS = 'C' OR BI.STATUS = 'R') THEN '신규' WHEN BI.PRODUCT_CLOSE_FLAG = 'S' AND (BI.STATUS = 'C' OR BI.STATUS = 'R') THEN '기등록' WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ICOMCQDT WHERE BUYER = CP.BYCA_COMORG_CODE AND BUYER_ITEM_NO = A.BUYER_ITEM_NO AND BELOW_COMORG_CODE = A.BUYER AND STATUS IN ('C','R')) = 0 THEN '신규' ELSE CASE WHEN A.ATOB_SEND_FLAG = 'N' THEN CASE WHEN A.BTOA_NEGO_PRICE = 0 THEN '기등록' ELSE '고객사NEGO건' END WHEN A.ATOB_SEND_FLAG = 'Y' THEN '고객사NEGO건' END END AS SIGNAL, A.BUYER_ITEM_NO, CASE WHEN C.AGENT IS NOT NULL THEN '협력사선정완료' ELSE CASE WHEN B.AGENT_REVISION = '1' THEN '협력사견적요청' ELSE '협력사재견적요청' END END AS STATUS, A.DESCRIPTION, A.SPECIFICATION, A.MAKER_NAME, (SELECT OG.TEXT2 FROM ICOMCOD1 OG WHERE OG.CODE = A.ORIGIN_CODE AND OG.TYPE = 'M001' AND OG.FLAG = 'Y') AS ORIGN_NAME, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM KEPQTDT WHERE BUYER = A.BUYER AND QUOTATION_NO = A.QUOTATION_NO AND QUOTATION_SEQ = A.QUOTATION_SEQ AND REVISION = A.REVISION AND STATUS = 'C' AND SEL_USER_ID IS NOT NULL) || '/' || (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM KEPQTDT WHERE BUYER = A.BUYER AND QUOTATION_NO = A.QUOTATION_NO AND QUOTATION_SEQ = A.QUOTATION_SEQ AND REVISION = A.REVISION AND STATUS = 'C') AS QUOTA_CNT, C.AGENT, (SELECT CMPY.COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY CMPY WHERE CMPY.COM_CODE = C.AGENT) AS AGENT_NAME, C.ATOB_UNIT_PRICE, C.STOA_LIST_PRICE, CASE WHEN A.BUYER IN ('KRPOON0010','KRDOOS0015','KRDOOD0001') THEN CASE WHEN C.ATOB_UNIT_PRICE = 0 OR C.STOA_LIST_PRICE = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND((C.ATOB_UNIT_PRICE - C.STOA_LIST_PRICE) / C.STOA_LIST_PRICE * 100, 1) END ELSE CASE WHEN C.ATOB_UNIT_PRICE = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND((C.ATOB_UNIT_PRICE - C.STOA_LIST_PRICE) / C.ATOB_UNIT_PRICE * 100, 1) END END AS RATE, B.ATOS_DATE AS ATOS_DATE, SUBSTR(B.ATOS_END_DATE,1,4) ||'/'||SUBSTR(B.ATOS_END_DATE,5,2) || '/' ||SUBSTR(B.ATOS_END_DATE,7,2)|| ' ' || SUBSTR(B.ATOS_END_TIME,1,2) || ':'|| SUBSTR(B.ATOS_END_TIME,3,2) AS ATOS_END_DT, B.ATOS_END_DATE||B.ATOS_END_TIME AS ATOS_END_DATE, B.ADMIN_CLOSE_FLAG, A.KEP_USER_ID, (SELECT USR.USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR USR WHERE USR.USER_ID = A.KEP_USER_ID AND STATUS IN ('C','R')) AS KEP_USER, A.BTOA_USER_ID AS BTOA_USER_ID, A.BTOA_USER_NAME AS BTOA_USER_NAME, A.BTOA_USER_TEL, A.STATUS AS RQDT_STATUS, A.UNIT_MEASURE, C.LEAD_TIME, A.ATOS_REMARK, A.BUYER_TARGET_PRICE, A.ADMIN_TARGET_PRICE, CP.BYCA_COMORG_CODE, CASE WHEN B.ATOS_END_DATE||B.ATOS_END_TIME < TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS END_TIME_FLAG, A.ITEM_QTY, A.IMAGE_KEY, NVL(TRIM(C.STOA_REMARK),'') AS STOA_REMARK, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(A.BTOA_END_DATE,'YYYY/MM/DD'),'YYYY/MM/DD') || ' ' || SUBSTR(A.BTOA_END_TIME,1,2) || ':'|| SUBSTR(A.BTOA_END_TIME,3,2) AS BTOA_END_DT, A.REG_ITEM_NO, CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM KEPQTDT WHERE BUYER = A.BUYER AND QUOTATION_NO = A.QUOTATION_NO AND QUOTATION_SEQ = A.QUOTATION_SEQ AND REVISION = A.REVISION AND STATUS = 'C' AND SEL_USER_ID IS NULL) > 0 THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END AS SEND_FLAG, A.CONTRACT_NO, A.CONTRACT_SEQ, CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM KEPQTDT QTDT WHERE QTDT.BUYER = B.BUYER AND QTDT.QUOTATION_NO = B.QUOTATION_NO AND QTDT.QUOTATION_SEQ = B.QUOTATION_SEQ AND QTDT.REVISION = B.REVISION AND QTDT.STATUS = 'C' AND NVL(QTDT.STOA_LIST_PRICE,0) != 0 AND NVL(QTDT.ATOB_UNIT_PRICE,0) != 0 AND QTDT.BID_SUCCESS_FLAG = 'Y' AND EXISTS (SELECT 'X' FROM KEP_BUYER_RATE C WHERE TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN C.FROM_DATE AND C.TO_DATE AND C.BUYER = QTDT.BUYER AND C.RATE*.9 >= (1-QTDT.STOA_LIST_PRICE/QTDT.ATOB_UNIT_PRICE)*100)) = 0 THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END AS RATE_FLAG, A.CMS_CATLG_ID, A.SG_ID, A.REFER_MAPPING_FLAG, A.ATOB_REMARK, C.SELLER_IMAGE_KEY, NVL(A.ITEM_GROUP,'M') AS ITEM_GROUP, NVL(MIN(DECODE(NVL(B.STOA_LIST_PRICE, 0), 0, NULL, B.STOA_LIST_PRICE) * NVL(B.ITEM_QTY, 1)) OVER (PARTITION BY B.BUYER, B.QUOTATION_NO, B.QUOTATION_SEQ, B.REVISION), 0) AS AGENT_MIN_PRICE, NVL(A.RFQ_KEP_USER,'') AS RFQ_KEP_USER, (SELECT USR.USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR USR WHERE USR.USER_ID = A.RFQ_KEP_USER AND STATUS IN ('C','R')) AS RFQ_KEP_USER_NAME, A.PLANT , A.AGENT_OPEN_FLAG , CP.AGENT_OPEN_FLAG AS CP_AGENT_OPEN_FLAG , A.CANCEL_REMARK , A.BTOA_REMARK , A.BELOW_COMORG_CODE , A.MSDS_YN , A.MSDS_NO ,F_GET_RE_SGMNG(A.BUYER, A.CMS_CATEG_ID,#{st_user_id} ,1) AS SG_KEP_YN ,F_GET_RE_SGMNG(A.BUYER, A.CMS_CATEG_ID,#{st_user_id} ,0) AS SG_GBN ,F_GET_RE_SGMNG(A.BUYER, A.CMS_CATEG_ID,'' ,3) AS SOUR_MNG , (SELECT USR.USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR USR WHERE USR.USER_ID =A.JOB_TRANSFER_ID) AS JOB_TRANSFER_NM ,A.JOB_TRANSFER_ID ,TO_CHAR(A.JOB_TRANSFER_DATE,'YYYY/MM/DD HH24:MI') AS JOB_TRANSFER_DATE ,A.MAKER_PART_NO ,A.MAKER_CODE ,CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM KEPQTDT QT WHERE QT.BUYER = A.BUYER AND QT.QUOTATION_NO = A.QUOTATION_NO AND QT.QUOTATION_SEQ = A.QUOTATION_SEQ AND QT.REVISION = A.REVISION AND QT.STATUS = 'C' AND SEL_USER_ID IS NOT NULL) = 0 THEN 'Y' WHEN TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') <= B.ATOS_END_DATE||B.ATOS_END_TIME AND B.ADMIN_CLOSE_FLAG = 'N' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS EXTEND_FLAG ,DECODE(A.DELAY_REASON_CODE,'','8','9') AS DELAY_REASON_IMG ,A.DELAY_REASON_CODE ,A.DELAY_SEND_MAIL_FLAG ,A.REF_NO ,C.PROCESS_TYPE ,C.MIN_ORDER_QTY ,C.PUR_UNIT_QTY ,NVL(A.BUYER_MSDS_YN,'N') AS BUYER_MSDS_YN , F_GET_PLANT_MNG(A.BUYER ,A.PLANT ,'REMG' ,'NM') AS PLANT_USER_NM ,(SELECT USR.USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR USR WHERE USR.USER_ID = B.ADD_USER_ID) AS QTDT_ADD_USER_NM , A.WAREHOUSE_CODE , A.PROCESS_TYPE AS RQDT_PROCESS_TYPE , A.ATOA_REMARK , NVL(A.AFTER_CMS_REJECT_FLAG, 'N') AS AFTER_CMS_REJECT_YN , A.AFTER_ITEM_CHG_REQ_ID , A.AFTER_ITEM_CHG_REQ_DATE , A.AFTER_ITEM_CHG_REQ_NOTE , A.AFTER_ITEM_CHG_REQ_IMAGE_KEY , A.AFTER_ITEM_MD_USER_ID , A.AFTER_ITEM_MD_DATE , (SELECT REQ.ITEM_MD_REVISION FROM KEP_AFTER_ITEM_MD_REQ REQ WHERE REQ.BUYER = A.BUYER AND REQ.QUOTATION_NO = A.QUOTATION_NO AND REQ.QUOTATION_SEQ = A.QUOTATION_SEQ AND REQ.REVISION = A.REVISION AND REQ.ITEM_MD_STATUS = 'C') AS AFTER_ITEM_MD_REVISION , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM KEPRQDT J WHERE J.BUYER = A.BUYER AND J.QUOTATION_NO = A.QUOTATION_NO AND J.SO_CA_FLAG = 'SO' AND J.ATOB_UNIT_PRICE = 0 AND J.ATOB_SEND_FLAG != 'Y' AND J.RECV_FLAG NOT IN ('GD', 'PM', 'TS','GS') AND J.STATUS IN ('C','R') ) AS RQDT_CNT , A.ASSIGN_AGENT_CODE , A.BTOA_NEGO_PRICE , (SELECT MAX(REQ_NO) FROM KEP_CMC_REQ WHERE BUYER = A.BUYER AND QUOTATION_NO = A.QUOTATION_NO AND QUOTATION_SEQ = A.QUOTATION_SEQ AND REVISION = A.REVISION AND REQ_STATUS NOT IN ('D', 'N')) AS CMC_REQ_NO , (SELECT DECODE(COUNT(*), 0, 'Y', 'N') FROM KEP_AFTER_ITEM_MD_REQ WHERE BUYER = A.BUYER AND QUOTATION_NO = A.QUOTATION_NO AND QUOTATION_SEQ = A.QUOTATION_SEQ AND REVISION = A.REVISION AND ITEM_MD_STATUS = 'C' AND ITEM_MD_USER_ID IS NULL) AS AFTER_ITEM_MD_COMPLETE , (SELECT ITEM_MD_REQ_TYPE FROM KEP_AFTER_ITEM_MD_REQ REQ WHERE REQ.BUYER = A.BUYER AND REQ.QUOTATION_NO = A.QUOTATION_NO AND REQ.QUOTATION_SEQ = A.QUOTATION_SEQ AND REQ.REVISION = A.REVISION AND REQ.ITEM_MD_STATUS = 'C') AS AFTER_ITEM_CHG_REQ_TYPE , A.CMS_CATEG_ID AS CMS_CATEG_ID FROM KEPRQDT A INNER JOIN KEPQTDT B ON (1 = 1 AND B.BUYER = A.BUYER AND B.QUOTATION_NO = A.QUOTATION_NO AND B.QUOTATION_SEQ = A.QUOTATION_SEQ AND B.REVISION = A.REVISION AND B.STATUS = 'C' ) LEFT OUTER JOIN KEPQTDT C ON (1 = 1 AND C.BUYER = A.BUYER AND C.QUOTATION_NO = A.QUOTATION_NO AND C.QUOTATION_SEQ = A.QUOTATION_SEQ AND C.REVISION = A.REVISION /* AND C.BUYER_ITEM_NO = A.BUYER_ITEM_NO */ AND C.BID_SUCCESS_FLAG = 'Y' AND C.STATUS = 'C' ) LEFT OUTER JOIN ICOMCMPY CP ON (1 = 1 AND CP.COM_CODE = A.BUYER ) LEFT OUTER JOIN ICOMBYIT BI ON (1 = 1 AND BI.BUYER = CP.BYCA_COMORG_CODE AND BI.BUYER_ITEM_NO = A.BUYER_ITEM_NO ) WHERE 1 = 1
AND A.BUYER IN
#{item}
AND A.BUYER IN ((SELECT BUYER FROM MIS_BUYER_MNG WHERE YEAR=TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY') AND STATUS='C' AND KEP_USER_ID=#{st_kep_user_id}))
AND A.QUOTATION_NO LIKE '%' || TRIM(#{st_quotation_no}) || '%'
AND A.BUYER_ITEM_NO LIKE '%' || #{st_buyer_item_no} || '%'
AND (A.DESCRIPTION LIKE '%' || #{st_desc_spec} || '%' OR A.SPECIFICATION LIKE '%' || #{st_desc_spec} || '%')
